### Load Libraries  

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel) # for repelling labels
library(ggthemes)
library(lubridate)
library(cmocean) # colors
```

### Read Data  
```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# Read in the data and convert the date
hobo_path <-here("Data", "Hobo_Files", "HOBO_Temp_Light") # folder with all hobo temp/lux data

hobo_files <- list.files(path = hobo_path, pattern = "\\.csv$",full.names = TRUE,recursive = TRUE) # bring in all of the individual files
```

### Clean the Data  
```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false

HoboData<- function(file) { # create a funciton to edit all the csv files so they are the same
  df<-read.csv(file) # read csv files
  columns<-c(grep("^Date", names(df), value = TRUE)[1], # find only 3 columns needed
             grep("^Temperature", names(df), value = TRUE)[1],
             grep("^Light", names(df), value = TRUE)[1])
  if (anyNA(columns)) { # check for NAs
    stop("Missing column in: ", file)
  }
  
  df<-df |> # clean the data 
    select(all_of(columns)) |> # only keep date temp lux columns for all files
    set_names(c("Date_Time", "Temperature_C", "Light_Lux")) |> # rename them b/c names were bad
    mutate(Date_Time = parse_date_time(Date_Time, # convert date and time using lubridate
                                       orders = c("mdY HMS", "mdY HM", "Ymd HMS", "Ymd HM"), # convert character strings into POSIXct date time values, formats to recognize
                                       tz = "Pacific/Honolulu"), # HI time zone (HST)
           Temperature_C = as.numeric(Temperature_C), # convert to numeric values
           Light_Lux = as.numeric(Light_Lux),
           source_file = basename(file)) |>  # create new column to id which csv corresponds to which row
    filter(Date_Time >= min(Date_Time, na.rm = TRUE) + minutes(30),
           Date_Time <= max(Date_Time, na.rm = TRUE) - hour(1)) # remove first 30 min and last hourfrom each file because automatic logging may have started during deployment
  return(df)
}
```

#### Read and Clean PAR Data
```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false


# PAR data to cross-calibrate
PAR_path<-here("Data","Hobo_Files", "PAR2026")

PARData <- function(file) { # function to clean PAR data
  df <- read.csv(file)
  df <- df |>
    select(Date_Time = starts_with("Date.Time"),
           Underwater_PAR = starts_with("Underwater.PAR"),
           Air_PAR = starts_with("In.Air.PAR"), # offshore PAR data doesnt have air par column so needed to do this
           Temperature_C = starts_with("Temperature"),
           Tilt_deg = starts_with("Tilt")) |> 
    #set_names(c("Date_Time","Underwater_PAR","Air_PAR","Temperature_C","Tilt_deg",
                #"DLI_Underwater","Accumulated_PAR")) |> # rename columns
    mutate(Date_Time = mdy_hms(Date_Time, tz = "Pacific/Honolulu"), # convert time so its the same as other files
      across(-Date_Time, ~ parse_number(as.character(.x))))
  
  if (!"Air_PAR" %in% names(df)) { # adds Air_PAR column b/c offshore file is missing it, this helps for the calibration code later
    df$Air_PAR <- NA_real_
  }
  
  return(df)
}
```


#### Combine the Data  
```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# Make datasets for all hobo data then separate into inshore data and offshore data only
HoboData_all<-map_dfr(hobo_files, HoboData) # all csv file data combined

HoboData_in<- HoboData_all |> # Inshore data only
  filter(str_detect(source_file, "^Hobo_IN")) # only csv files for inshore data

HoboData_off <- HoboData_all |> # Offshore data only
  filter(str_detect(source_file, "^Hobo_OF"))  # only csv files for offshore data

# do the same for PAR data
PAR_off_cal<- PARData(here(PAR_path, "PAR_OFF_22491164_cal2.csv")) # Offshore data for calibration in Aug
```


### Convert Lux to PAR  
*Hobo_OFF_22235022_Aug*  
* Offshore HOBO at start of transect was used with a PAR logger put out at same time  
* Excel name: PAR22491164-OFF 2026-08-13 10_01_33 HST (Data HST).xlsx  
* only one Hobo inshore logger from 24 hour July sampling had data but was not near PAR logger  
* For calibration, we are using the re-calibration done in August with an offshore Hobo and PAR logger on 2026-08-12  
```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# filter out just the hobo data used along side PAR deployment
Light_off<-HoboData_off |>
  filter(source_file == "Hobo_OFF_22235022_Aug.csv") |> 
# merge the hobo files with PAR files to calibrate by date/time and inshore/ offshore
  inner_join(PAR_off_cal, by = 'Date_Time', suffix = c("_HOBO", "_PAR")) # so we know values are from which sensor (columns have same name)

# convert LUX to uMol m-2 s-1

#plot PAR μmol/m²/s by light lux
#fit an exponential function following Long et al. 2012
mod_off <- nls(Underwater_PAR ~ A1*exp(-Light_Lux/t1) +y0,  # PAR in μmol/m²/s
           data = Light_off, start = list(A1 = -84000, t1 = 84000, y0 = 84000)) #t1 = min&max difference, A1=min-max, y0=maxPAR


# plot lux and PAR
ggplot(Light_off, aes(x = Light_Lux, y = Underwater_PAR)) + # Inshore
  geom_point() +
  #geom_line(aes(y = predict(mod_off)),color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_function(fun = function(x) 
    {coef(mod_off)["A1"] *exp(-x / coef(mod_off)["t1"]) + coef(mod_off)["y0"]},
                color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(x = "Light (lux)",y = "Underwater PAR (µmol/m²/s)")


# calibrate the light intensities to PAR based on this fit
m_off<-summary(mod_off)$coefficients[,1] # pull out the coefficients from the model
```
Notes:  
* PAR = A1 \times e^{-Lux/t1}+y0  
* A1: Controls the magnitude and direction of the exponential component  
* t1: Controls how quickly the curve approaches its asymptote as lux increases  
* y0: The horizontal asymptote that PAR approaches at high lux, assuming t1 is positive (i think these are true)  

#### Estimated PAR for all data  
Added new column to datasets 
```{r}
HoboData_off<-HoboData_off |> #convert offshore data to PAR to test
  mutate(PAR_estimate = predict(mod_off, newdata = HoboData_off)) 

HoboData_in<-HoboData_in |> #convert inshore data to PAR
  mutate(PAR_estimate = predict(mod_off, newdata = HoboData_in)) 

HoboData_all<-HoboData_all |> #convert offshore data to PAR to test
  mutate(PAR_estimate = predict(mod_off, newdata = HoboData_all)) 
```


### Plot the Light Data  
```{r}
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| out-width: "70%"
#| fig-align: "center"
#| label: fig-hobolight
#| fig-cap: "Figure # shows light (PAR) over time between inshore and offshore zones at Paiko, Maunalua Bay."
#| include: true
#| eval: true
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 8

# create a column for zone to differentiate the hobo datasets
HoboData_all<-HoboData_all |> 
  mutate(zone = case_when(str_detect(source_file, "^Hobo_IN") ~ "Inshore", # all files with "Hobo_IN" name as inshore
                          str_detect(source_file, "^Hobo_OF") ~ "Offshore"))

# plot calculated PAR (from calibration) over time
PaikoLight<-HoboData_all |> 
  filter(!is.na(zone)) |> # filter by zone
  ggplot(aes(x = Date_Time, y = PAR_estimate,
           color = zone, group = interaction(zone, source_file))) + # separate lines for gaps in data over time
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.25, alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(vars(Month = month(Date_Time, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE)), # make 2 rows of plots by month
             scales = "free_x",ncol = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Inshore" = "#e6cc00","Offshore" = "#e69b00")) + # light colors
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 2100))+ # y-axis max larger
  #scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "2 weeks",date_labels = "%b %d",timezone = "Pacific/Honolulu") + # x-axis dates 
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 3, alpha = 1))) + # make legen lines thicker
  labs(x = "Date", y = expression("PAR ("*mu*"mol photons "*m^-2*s^-1*")"), #"PAR (µmol/m²/s)"
       title = "Underwater Light (PAR) Time Series",
       subtitle = "Paikō Beach, July–October 2026",
       color = "Zone") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "top")

PaikoLight

#ggsave(here("Output","EnviroParameters", "PaikoLight2026.png")) 
```

### Calculate Means  
```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# averages
# calculate mean and SD for temperature and PAR
LightTempMeans <- HoboData_all |>
  filter(!is.na(zone)) |>
  group_by(zone) |>
  summarise(mean_temp = mean(Temperature_C, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_temp = sd(Temperature_C, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_PAR = mean(PAR_estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_PAR = sd(PAR_estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")
```
